invite_links_hint: Anyone with the link can join after signing in; no email verification is required. Share it only with people who should join and revoke it when it is no longer needed.
invite_links_role_member: Member (read-only settings, can use the workbench)
invite_links_role_admin: Admin (can change settings and manage members)
invite_links_max_uses_hint: Leave empty for no limit (seat limits still apply).
invite_links_created: Link created. It is shown only once, so copy it now.
invite_links_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it manually.
invite_links_revoke_confirm: The link stops working immediately. Revoke it?
invite_links_failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
join_signed_out: You have been invited to a team workspace. Sign in or create an account first; you will come back here afterwards.
join_prompt_hint: You will enter this team workspace with that role. You can leave or be removed by an admin at any time.
join_error_invalid: This invite link is invalid. Ask a workspace admin for a new one.
join_error_expired: This invite link has expired. Ask a workspace admin for a new one.
join_error_revoked: This invite link has been revoked. Ask a workspace admin for a new one.
join_error_exhausted: This invite link has reached its usage limit. Ask a workspace admin for a new one.
join_error_inactive: This invite link is no longer valid because its creator no longer manages the workspace. Ask a workspace admin for a new one.
join_error_seats_full: This workspace has no free seats. Contact a workspace admin.
join_error_disabled: Team features are disabled, so you cannot join a team workspace right now.
join_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
join_error_impersonating: You cannot join a workspace while impersonating.
join_error_session: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
join_error_unknown: Could not join. Please try again.
